description: 46Labs termination media IP traffic, quality, routing, failures, and margin analytics.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(attempts) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${media_ip:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote})

SELECT sum(completions) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${media_ip:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote})

SELECT round(100.0 * sum(completions) / nullIf(sum(attempts), 0), 2) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${media_ip:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote})

SELECT round(sum(billed_seconds) / 60.0, 2) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${media_ip:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote})

SELECT round(sum(revenue), 2) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${media_ip:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote})

SELECT round(sum(cost), 2) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${media_ip:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote})

SELECT round(sum(revenue) - sum(cost), 2) AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${media_ip:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote})
SELECT uniqExactIf(term_media_ip, term_media_ip != '(none)') AS value FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote})

SELECT hour AS time, sum(attempts) AS Attempts, sum(completions) AS Completions FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${media_ip:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}) GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

SELECT term_media_ip, sum(attempts) AS attempts FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND term_media_ip != '(none)' AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) GROUP BY term_media_ip ORDER BY attempts DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT term_media_ip AS `Term Media IP`, any(term_ip) AS `Signaling IP`, arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(5)(term_carrier_name), ', ') AS Vendors, arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(5)(term_trunk_group_name), ', ') AS Trunks, sum(attempts) AS Attempts, sum(completions) AS Completions, round(100.0 * sum(completions) / nullIf(sum(attempts), 0), 2) AS `ASR %`, round(sum(billed_seconds) / 60.0, 2) AS Minutes, round(sum(revenue), 2) AS Revenue, round(sum(cost), 2) AS Cost, round(sum(revenue) - sum(cost), 2) AS Margin, round(sum(mos_sum) / nullIf(sum(mos_count), 0), 2) AS `Avg MOS`, round(sum(pdd_sum) / nullIf(sum(pdd_count), 0), 1) AS `Avg PDD` FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND term_media_ip != '(none)' AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${media_ip:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}) GROUP BY term_media_ip ORDER BY Attempts DESC LIMIT 500

SELECT term_media_ip AS `Term Media IP`, sip_code AS `SIP Code`, reason AS `Release Cause`, sum(attempts) AS Attempts FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND sip_code != 200 AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${media_ip:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}) GROUP BY term_media_ip, sip_code, reason ORDER BY Attempts DESC LIMIT 250

panels.title: Failures by Media IP and Release Cause

targets.rawSql: SELECT term_media_ip AS `Term Media IP`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Origin Trunk`, sum(attempts) AS Attempts, round(100.0 * sum(completions) / nullIf(sum(attempts), 0), 2) AS `ASR %`, round(sum(revenue) - sum(cost), 2) AS Margin FROM cdr.cdr_hourly_media_ip WHERE $__timeFilter(hour) AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${media_ip:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}) GROUP BY term_media_ip, orig_trunk_group_name ORDER BY Attempts DESC LIMIT 250

SELECT event_time AS Time, entity AS Entity, term_media_ip AS `Term Media IP`, term_ip AS `Term Signaling IP`, term_carrier_name AS Vendor, term_trunk_group_name AS `Term Trunk`, orig_trunk_group_name AS `Origin Trunk`, from_did AS ANI, to_did AS DNIS, sip_code AS `SIP Code`, reason AS `Release Cause`, duration_real AS `Duration Sec`, round(orig_cost, 6) AS Revenue, round(term_cost, 6) AS Cost, stir_attest AS Attest, round(mos_avg, 2) AS MOS, callid AS `Call ID` FROM cdr.raw_cdr WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND ${media_ip:singlequote} != 'All' AND term_media_ip = ${media_ip:singlequote} AND (${entity:singlequote} = 'All' OR entity = ${entity:singlequote}) AND (${vendor:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_carrier_name = ${vendor:singlequote}) AND (${trunk:singlequote} = 'All' OR term_trunk_group_name = ${trunk:singlequote}) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 1000
